now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: Thor gets the Reality Stone in 2013 and fights Thanos. Afterward, he names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.
cases: ST-079 The Battle of Earth (Avengers: Endgame)

proposed.text: In 2013, Thor reclaims Mjolnir while Rocket takes the Reality Stone, and he later fights Thanos. Afterward, he names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.

changes.evidence: Endgame plot: on Asgard in 2013, Rocket extracts the Reality Stone from Jane Foster, while Thor is encouraged by Frigga and retrieves Mjolnir. Thor does not get the Reality Stone himself.
